description: This file contains code implementing a specialized pattern matching and code generation pass for optimized batched matrix multiplication (B2B GEMM) in PyTorch's torch._inductor backend. It defines pattern matches for mm operations, configuration for kernel choices, and functions to build and select optimized subgraphs, including Triton kernel templates, autotuning logic, and heuristics for when to use B2B GEMM operations.

classes.name: PatternMatcherPass
classes.description: Represents a pattern matching pass used in the graph rewrite process for optimizing GEMM operations.

classes.name: TensorBox
classes.description: Abstracts tensor representations within the subgraph generation and optimization pipeline.

classes.name: Subgraph
classes.description: Represents a subgraph of computation to be used as a kernel in the optimized GEMM passes.

classes.name: ComputedBuffer
classes.description: Data structure for storing computed subgraph results before inlining.

classes.name: FlexibleLayout
classes.description: Defines a flexible memory layout for tensor buffers.

classes.name: InputBuffer
classes.description: Represents an input buffer for subgraph computation.

classes.name: StorageBox
classes.description: A box wrapping storage tensor objects.

classes.name: TritonTemplate
classes.description: Represents a Triton kernel template used in code generation for B2B GEMM.

classes.name: TritonTemplateCaller
classes.description: Represents an autotuned and selected instance of a Triton kernel template.
